Follow the poled route from Hope Kiwi Lodge along the forest edge to the Hope River swingbridge about 30 minutes from the hut.
Five minutes down a shingle road is the shelter and car park at Windy Point, beside SH 7.

evidence: After crossing the swingbridge over Boyle River, follow a vehicle track that climbs through mānuka and tussock.
It eventually drops to the Hope Halfway Hut.
From here the hut is 30 minutes away, via a poled route across open terraces and through sections of forest to Hope Kiwi Lodge.
From Hope Kiwi Lodge, you can access the Hope Pass Track.

doubts: The Hurunui swing bridge start has no feature or name entry, so its ref is null; it is reached by a 9 km 4WD track from Loch Katrine. Windy Point car park is taken to be F1 (unnamed track meeting Lewis Pass Road, next to Windy Point T13). DOC's 18 hr 30 min / 33 km is given for the main way although the three leg times sum to 11 hr 30 min; it may include the Loch Katrine access. The page also describes the track from Windy Point but only as far as Hope Kiwi Lodge (W2); whether that is a return trip or continues (e.g. onto Hope Pass Track) is not said, so its shape is null. Which lake the Kiwi Saddle lookout views is not named (likely not on the way either way).
